changes.previous: Native declarations carried a qualified annotation argument and a native placeholder body.
changes.current: Handwritten native declarations use a parameter-free @compiler.native annotation and no body.
changes.guidance: Remove the redundant symbol argument and native body, then rebuild native packages.

changes.previous: The fixed array collection was named FixedArray.
changes.current: The fixed array collection is named Array.
changes.guidance: Update FixedArray imports and type annotations to Array.

changes.previous: Public primary types could repeat the module name in their qualified path.
changes.current: Public primary type paths use their owning module directly.
changes.guidance: Update qualified type annotations and imports to their owning module's public type path.

changes.previous: Typed CSS exposed optional-property wrappers and getter APIs.
changes.current: Typed CSS accepts property values directly.
changes.guidance: Replace wrapper construction and getter calls with direct typed values and application-owned Option fields where needed.

changes.previous: terlc bind angular-ts selected compiler-owned declarations and added a synthetic framework facade.
changes.current: Angular.ts owns its Terlan package and selects declaration inputs through the generic TypeScript generator.
changes.guidance: Use Angular.ts integrations/terlan to generate bindings from the same directory as the selected runtime.

changes.previous: Native application deployment required a separate image and VM alongside the launcher.
changes.current: Native applications embed their image and VM in one executable.
changes.guidance: Deploy the rebuilt application executable and retain any separately configured external service dependencies.
